OET

Occupational English Test

The Occupational English Test paradoxically owes its increasing popularity to IELTS. Many medical professionals who find getting the required score in IELTS find comfort in the fact that they can fall back on the OET, which is considered to be easier to score in than the IELTS.

In India, OET is conducted once each month.

It is recommended that you register for the test at least 45 days in advance to ensure seat availability.

Owned by Cambridge Boxhill Language Assessment Trust (CBLAT), a venture between Cambridge English Language Assessment and Box Hill Institute.

The OET is recognized by healthcare bodies and councils in the UK, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and Dubai. The number of healtchare bodies that recognize the OET is constantly on the rise.

First Academy is the only institute that authors books on OET. We understand the requirements and the nuances of the test. We help you in understanding the text and thereby score better.

The material is aligned to meet the exacting standards set by the OET. In many cases, the material is sourced from actual case studies, patient interactions, and peer reviewed articles for authenticity and accuracy.

Can I avoid taking the OET?

Yes, you do not need to take the OET. There are always options. You can in place of OET take the IELTS. Alternatively, if you are comfortable with English, you might not need any coaching. Take a free test to see how you fare in the OET!

What is your OET Success rate?

Our success rate is close to 100%. It might sound surprising, but almost all our students clear the OET in their first attempt. You only need to look at our reviews! or attend a free session to see how fantastic our classes are!

Yes. OET is a test designed to test the readiness of medical professionals. A good score in the OET can be a pathway for a career in the medical profession. We can help you chart the course.

About the Test

   The OET is available for 12 professions: Dentistry, Dietetics, Medicine, Nursing, Occupational Therapy, Optometry, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Podiatry, Radiography, Speech Pathology, and Veterinary Science.

   If you do not fall into any of these streams, you simply take the Writing and Speaking sub-test for the field that is closest to yours.

   The minimum score required for most purposes is Grade B in each sub-test. Just like most other English tests, OET scores are valid for 2 years.

The OET test registration costs AUD587 (Australian Dollars) as on 31st December 2023. There is one test date each month. It is best to book you test date about 45 days in advance.

Frequently Asked Questions

For how long are OET results valid? + −

The validity of the results is decided by the authorities that recognise OET. OET does not determine the validity. Each institute has a different set of requirements that are usually published on their respective websites.

Can I apply for revaluation? + −

Yes, you may apply for revaluation. However, in OET revaluation could result in decreased scores too. Unlike IELTS where your scores do not come down.

How soon should I apply for remarking? + −

You must apply for revaluation within 72 hours of your results being published.

Is there a 'General' version of the OET? + −

No, OET does not provide a generic test. If your profession is not one of the 12 listed, you may choose to sit the OET test for the profession which is closest to your own.

Do you have online OET training in Noida? + −

Our online OET coaching is attended by medical professionals from all over the world. From India in particular, our OET online coaching is popular in Noida, Chandigarh, Mumbai, Ludhiana, and Jaipur.

Internationally we have OET learners from Vietnam, the Middle East, the UK, Australia, several countries from Africa among many others!

The Best OET Coaching Centres - More Information + −

When most people look for an OET Coaching Centre, they do not really know what they ‘should’ actually look for. For instance, great google reviews are the first step. But that is not all. Great reviews are only one half of the picture. And we should also remember that all halves are not really equal. Some halves are more important than the others. So, which half is more important here? The half that cannot always be evaluated by learners – the quality of trainers. This is the half that can make all the difference. That is the area that First Academy excels at.

First Academy’s OET Coaching Centre has the most enviable track record of all – 100% success rate of OET candidates. This means that all of our OET learners have scored at least a Grade B in all modules of OET – and with over 20 years of experience – that is a record that almost no one else can boast of. We owe this success to our trainers – who are also India’s only author cum trainers of OET. This is why, our training is not just widely reviewed but also wildly successful. At First Academy – success is serious business.

Our OET Coaching centres are located in Hyderabad. You may visit any of our two training centres in Ameerpet or Madhapur. Both our centres are centrally located and easily accessible – they are close to or in the middle of thriving student and or commercial hubs. They are also bang beside major bus stops or subway stations. All our coaching centres allow first time learners to sit in a session to experience how the training is. Learners can also interact with the trainers and go through our material before enrolling for the best OET training program on the planet.

Which is the Best OET Online Coaching Centre + −

Looking for OET Online Coaching that is both interactive and intensive? First Academy’s sessions strike the perfect balance of both. Handled by one of India’s first OET authors, the sessions are detailed and are finely calibrated to the needs of the learners. These sessions have a limited number of seats to ensure that individual needs are taken care of, and learner experiences exceeded. This is one of the reasons why our OET sessions are consistently highly rated and reviewed. To experience these sessions, as our counsellors to arrange a free session for you where you can not only interact with the trainer but also with your fellow learners.

Another feature of our OET online coaching is the validity. Though the sessions can be completed in as little as two weeks, each of our sessions comes with extended validity that allows you to reattend any session any number of times within the duration of the validity. No questions asked. You can also interact with the trainers during the sessions since all our sessions are both live and trainer led. This will give you the opportunity to glean never-before insights into the test and how it is marked – giving you the opportunity to learn more, learn more easily and score better.

All our training program including the OET online coaching come with our exclusive and unique Writing Evaluations. In these, the trainers individually evaluate each learner’s writing tasks and provide them with valuable feedback and comments to help them understand not just where to improve but also how to improve. In addition to this, there are also one-to-one sessions with the trainer which the learner can take advantage of anytime during the period of the validity irrespective of whether the learner has completed his training.

How is the OET Preparation Course + −

Welcome to First Academy’s OET Preparation course. Our preparation course comes in two flavours – Online and Classroom training. Both these programs are equally interactive, and equally excellent. Both flavours of our our OET course are widely acclaimed to be the best courses in India. No matter which course you choose, all the additional benefits will continue to remain the same along with the ancillary features remaining on par. This is one of many unique benefits you will have when you enrol with us. That our trainers are also authors is just the icing on the already delicious cake!

The OET preparation course at First Academy comes with four features that can be found nowhere else! One is that you are trained by OET authors. We are India’s only training institute that are able to offer such quality. The second is that every learner get to have his or her personal time with the trainer that is over and above the regular classroom or online training that is offered. The third is OET writing evaluations – where the learners can submit writing tasks and each of those tasks is evaluated and commented upon by the trainers. This is in addition to the personal speaking sessions the candidates can take with their trainers.

These are what make our OET preparation course awesome. The course caters to all levels or leaners and caters to all forms of learning. There is the opportunity to be a part of a group where you can learn from the questions and the queries of your co-leaners and then there is also the opportunity to ask questions and discuss problems that are unique to you. You get the best of both worlds. Anytime you wish to attend a session – we will be happy to help you attend a session that too for free. This will help you understand how our sessions and trainers are before you enrol for a program of your choice.
